london-south-downs-and-beachy-head-day.title: London · South Downs and Beachy Head Day
london-south-downs-and-beachy-head-day.slogan: A 227 km loop out of Box Hill rider
london-south-downs-and-beachy-head-day.story: Chalk, sea air and sweepers that justify the alarm clock. A 227 km loop that starts and ends near Dorking, about 4 h 22 of riding. The stops in between: Seven Sisters cliffs, Beachy Head and Lewes. Ditchling Beacon is the high point. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: Town Hall and Roland on the Marketplace of → Wadden Sea
